reviews.title: Decent, can be better
reviews.text: My previous app was Trainiac/Gympass before they dropped me because I didn’t have a insurance plan that used them. Honestly they were a better value, half of what Future charges, for the same features. My trainer has been responsive to what I want. I’m giving the 2 stars because I want to see my previous notes/flags in my workout history and better support for Garmin watches. Heck, load an app onto Garmin Connect and I’ll download it to make the $200/mo worth it.

reviews.text: I was skeptical about this at first, but it’s totally worth the expense. For me, I need skin in the game to keep me engaged and motivated to work out consistently. I’ve had 2 trainers and they’ve both been great.

reviews.title: Giving me motivation again

I absolutely love this app! My coach, Sydney, is amazing!  she is incredibly encouraging while also holding me accountable to my workouts and nutrition.

She is always there to offer advice, help me make adjustments to my eating habits, and talk through both my successes and struggles. I truly feel like she cares about my progress and wants to help me become the healthiest version of myself.

This app and the coaching are well worth the money. It’s not just an expense. it’s an investment in your health and your future! I highly recommend it!

reviews.title: Best investment

reviews.title: The Best
reviews.text:
Future has completely changed the way I approach fitness. I’ve tried different workout programs and apps over the years, but nothing has kept me as consistent, motivated, and accountable as Future.

The biggest difference is having a real coach who actually knows you, your goals, your schedule, and what equipment you have available. My workouts aren’t just some generic program pulled from a library they’re built around me and adjusted based on how I’m progressing, how I’m feeling, and what I have going on that week.

I also travel for work, and Future makes it incredibly easy to stay consistent. Whether I’m at home with all my equipment or in a hotel with a couple dumbbells and a treadmill, my coach can adjust my workout so there’s really no excuse to skip it.

The accountability has probably been the biggest game changer. Knowing that someone is paying attention to whether I’m getting my workouts done adds an entirely different level of motivation. At the same time, it doesn’t feel overbearing it feels like having someone in your corner who genuinely wants to see you succeed.

I’ve made significant progress since using Future, but more importantly, working out has become part of my routine instead of something I constantly have to convince myself to do.

If you’re someone who struggles with consistency, gets bored following generic programs, travels frequently, or just wants the structure and accountability of a personal trainer without having to meet someone at a gym every day, Future is absolutely worth it.

One of the best investments I’ve made in myself and my fitness.

reviews.title: Incredible workout platform !
reviews.text:
My coach Merlee dials up the most fun yet challenging workout routines that keep me consistently coming back for more every week. She keeps the routines fresh and does an awesome job of integrating all of the equipment I have access to. She also knows which exercises are my favorites and includes them often.  
Broke my neck and back in a mtn bike crash and thanks to my Future coach Merlee, have bounced back nicely. After six months of Future workouts and local PT I am feeling much stronger and back on the trails. Looking forward to more progress in my fitness journey! Great platform and app!!

reviews.title: Love it!

reviews.title: Nicole is the best!

reviews.title: Amazing App, Bit Too Pricey
reviews.text:
This app is great if you have the money for it. It is wonderful for consistency and accountability. The workouts are well-structured and easy to follow. It’s a really great comprehensive interface. I wish I could use it to make my own workouts. 

It’s not really accessible to those on a lower or fixed income, though. Once again, wellness is gate-kept by the well-off. If there were some kind of option to be able to use the interface without a trainer, I’d absolutely go for it. I don’t think it would keep people from using the human trainer aspect. There’s nothing that will beat that one-on-one custom-tailored training, workouts, and accountabili-buddy that they offer. Not even AI. The trainers are all well-vetted and know their stuff. Many have advanced degrees in their field and extremely extensive experience. All are completely human. For someone that can afford it, I’d say this is a better option than whatever your gym or any other app will offer you.

For those that can’t afford it, I’d love to see Future have at least access to the workout environment. It doesn’t have to be AI. Maybe there could be some kind of educational aspect as well to empower people to create their own workouts. This interface seems like it would be great for people wanting to build their own programs. It would absolutely beat the notebook-and-pen system which I’ve found is better than any of the other workout-building apps out there. Even if Future offered workout-building access with the requirement of working with a trainer for 3-6 months at the full price then dropping it down to those that don’t want to continue with a trainer, it would be better than what they do now, which is cut off all access to your previous workouts, knowledge base, and history once you stop shelling out dough. 

This app could be truly great for people.

TLDR; The trainers are the best and AI won’t replace the personal attention you get but it’s just too expensive to be sustainable. I wish you could access the workout builder for personal use at a lower monthly price like $30-50 or something.

reviews.title: Kaya is amazing

reviews.title: Perfect for those with a home gym, but in need of a little bit of guidance
reviews.text: I used to prefer to go to the gym and work out, but over the years I’ve become more of a homebody. I built up a decent home gym, but really didn’t have a clear plan as to what I was going to do for my strength training. This app is perfect for me for someone who has a lot of tools at home for lifting but needed some guidance to make sure I was targeting all the right muscle groups consistently. The coaches (I’ve had 3)  are great and I’ve been with the app for a number of years. I don’t plan on leaving the app because I know if I continue to stick to the game plan I will see the results that I want.

reviews.title: What I needed!
reviews.text: I’ve had 4 kids with having two of them in within two years. I needed a way to stay consistent with my workouts and have the accountability without the crazy costs. Future Pro has changed everything for me. I’ve been using this app for the last 5 years and I’ve never looked or felt as strong as I do and now I’m in my 40s. I work out with my trainer on MY SCHEDULE and it has been amazing.

reviews.title: Great coaching, meh app
reviews.text:
My coach, Amber, has been great for me.  She’s supportive and has helped me grow in my fitness and work through and injury. Her availability for help and sending videos is top notch. 

However, the app is limiting. 2 simple examples: I had a shoulder injury- you cannot have different weight for right and left sided workouts, on runs there’s no cue to let you know when you’re at the 1/2 way mark, etc.  
for top pricing of the virtual coaching, it would be nice if they’d invest in better IT support

reviews.title: Transformed my life
reviews.text: I’ve been using Future for 5 or 6 years and no other form of exercise, let alone another fitness app (I’ve tried them all), has stuck and or so profoundly changed my inertia with physical activity. My coach right now, Anna Foley, is as important a part of my life as my therapist and PCP. She’s helped me through cancer and depression and menopause and all kinds of other ups and downs. I hear from her almost every day. She knows my partner’s name, my work sched, my pets, my hobbies, my dreams, my tells and pitfalls and, most importantly, the secret sauce that actually gets me moving.  I live in a rural area so I have limited access to trainers and gyms — but even my friends in Manhattan are on Future now bc they’ve seen the quality and outcomes I’ve achieved through the app. It is worth every penny. $200 a month for a true personal coach?!! An incredible deal. The price of three sessions per month of an IRL trainer. I hear from Anna 20 times a month. Everyone knows by now that consistency is the key to real transformation. Future — and Anna — have unlocked it for me and added years to my life.

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text:

Dew time and attention to reply to my messages and watch my videos on a daily basis has been incredible and worth every penny.

reviews.title: Best personal trainer ever!
reviews.text: I have worked with many personal trainers and fitness apps but Future gives you the best of personal training in a way that works for my life. My trainer, Kelsey, is the best I’ve ever worked with and I get the most personalized workouts. We interact all the time that I feel she’s always there coaching me. reviews.title: Engagement with coach is awesome!

reviews.title: Great trainer, app gets worse and worse
reviews.text: The app was pretty stable for me for several years but in the last few months a bug was introduced that makes my unscheduled workouts no longer save despite being tracked in app (so I lose all my heart rate data), and annoyingly in yesterday’s update the accessibility settings have been overwritten, leaving me impossibly tiny text that used to get scaled up like all apps on my phone, but looks like someone hard coded chat to stay small sized and as most of your clientele is over 40, this is a really dumb decision!

reviews.title: Future changed my life!!
reviews.text:
When you’re trying to reach a goal and can’t seem to accomplish it, you’re often missing a key ingredient: A COACH! Whether it’s for business, nutrition, fitness, relationship, or any area of personal growth A COACH helps layout the plan, holds accountability, and literally coaches through the emotional ups and downs. And it’s in the ups and downs where FUTURE has changed my life. Personal training has always made a huge difference in my fitness journey but most people can’t afford to pay a personal trainer for every workout. FUTURE bridges that gap. Providing a personal trainer, at an affordable cost, along with all the features of the APP, has helped me maintain a consistent fitness routine for nearly 18 months now. And the key for me has been all the times I fell off the horse and COACH RYAN coached me back on the horse every time. FUTURE + COACH RYAN = GAINS I HAVE ALWAYS WANTED BUT NEVER ACHIEVED UNTIL
NOW!

reviews.text:
Have been using future for many years know and the trainers and programming are excellent. 

The app goes through periods of being very buggy though. Right now it is causing AirPods to disconnect randomly during workouts, disrupting music and making the experience practically unusable. Given AI coding tools I would expect faster resolution of issues.

reviews.title: Such a great fitness app
reviews.text: After years of in person Bootcamp classes the pandemic hit and I had to try something else. So I got subscriptions to Peloton and Obé and while both are great apps, I hated being called “hustler” and all the other jargon that went along with peloton and then just couldn’t commit to a schedule with Obé. I was commuted to finding a personal trainer, like an in person personal trainer, when I came across Future. I absolutely love the interface and my coach, Laura, who texts me, checks in on me after workouts and makes sure I get my workout DONE! Accountability is important for me in working out and this app and it’s coach provides me with that!!

reviews.title: Great concept but frequent turnover and glitches
reviews.text: I’ve been using this for 3 plus years consistently. While the app updates have been good, the subscription price increases, recurring glitches that don’t get corrected for months, and coach turnover is a bit frustrating.

reviews.title: Great for Accountability & Instruction  - $200 is too high
reviews.text:
I’m on month 6 of using this app and my trainer has provided me with clear instructions and programmed exercises that I’ve never done before. This is a great app for anyone who needs accountability and for who wants more structure with their a workout plan. For me, I don’t need the accountability and I felt I learned everything I could have from the app. I met with my PT 1x a month and she sent me messages daily. 

I decided this will be my last month and I am creating my own plan based off the information I learned. It’s a high ticket price of $200 a month which is why I gave It a 4 star. I don’t feel it’s worth that high, I would say $100 matches the value you receive. 

If you’re starting out or getting back to working out, it’s worth It. But after that, you can do the programming yourself for free or little money.
